x: Andy Edwards had driven all the way from Sheffield to take part in the 'B' race but was so shattered by the experience that he felt he could not do himself justice; luckily we have a superb reserve in Ian Wells who ran to a fine 2nd place.

Belgrave's highest flyer in 1995, Ian Tullett cleared 5.30m to take British League Match 4 at Enfield. But Mike Edwards is keen to wrest back the lead and is rumoured to have recently vaulted 5.60 in training.
